changed.item: The original says the talk 'will draw on' his experience (a future event); the edit says it 'draws on' it (present tense), which slightly blurs that the talk has not yet happened.
The original credits 'his work' with providing the long-term perspective; the edit says 'that gives him a long view', shifting the source from his research output to him personally.
The original says he examines fire 'in landscapes where ecology, land management and policy meet'; the edit makes UK peatlands themselves the place 'where ecology, land management and policy meet'.
